set.body:
Scope: image/world declarations; minimal independently buildable neuroim4s-spaces module; generic WorldLink capability in reframe4s.

Deliverable: Bootstrap the neuroim4s repository with a small shared declaration module. Extract subject/template/world identity over core frame types; keep acquisition geometry/format evidence in validated adapters. Image and surface cores are siblings consuming this contract.

Acceptance:
- Declaration artifact has no dependency on image values/volume runtime, neuroim4s transforms/IO/view, mesh/surface runtime, atlas, MVPA or ScalaFIM.
- Generic coordinates, alignment and directional mapping remain spatial4s/reframe4s-owned; no new frame algebra or global registry is added.
- Subject/template world versus sampled resolution/atlas-release identities remain distinct; scanner/tkRAS and missing-inverse fixtures pass on JVM/JS.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U2: Extract shared anatomical declarations without a volume dependency
